title: Stop ruining your cast iron pan (Part 2)
hook: Stop soaking your rusted cast iron.

script.narration: Stop soaking your rusted cast iron.
script.visual_search: rusty cast iron skillet in sink

script.narration: First, scrub off the heavy flakes with steel wool and water.
Next, soak it in a fifty-fifty vinegar and water bath for just one hour to dissolve the remaining rust.
Finally, dry it completely on the stove and bake on a thin layer of oil.
Like if this helped, follow for daily kitchen tips. Have you ever restored a pan? Comment below to stop soaking your rusted cast iron.

description: Learn how to easily restore a completely rusted cast iron skillet using common household items like vinegar and oil. Bring your old cookware back to life in just a few simple steps. Follow for more quick kitchen care guides.
